in_sanskrit.name: Sorif
in_sanskrit.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है Bringer of Happiness
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Sorif एक संस्कृत नाम है जो हिंदू संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। One who brings joy and happiness to others, derived from the Sanskrit word 'Surya' meaning 'Sun' and 'Rup' meaning 'Form' or 'Appearance'

in_hindi.name: Sorif
in_hindi.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है Bringer of Happiness
in_hindi.long_meaning: Sorif एक हिंदू नाम है जो भारतीय संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। One who brings joy and happiness to others, derived from the Sanskrit word 'Surya' meaning 'Sun' and 'Rup' meaning 'Form' or 'Appearance'

in_tamil.name: Sorif
in_tamil.meaning: இந்து பெயர் என்று பொருள் Bringer of Happiness
in_tamil.long_meaning: Sorif ஒரு இந்து பெயர் ஆகும், இது இந்திய கலாச்சாரத்தில் ஆழமான ஆன்மீக முக்கியத்துவத்தைக் கொண்டுள்ளது। One who brings joy and happiness to others, derived from the Sanskrit word 'Surya' meaning 'Sun' and 'Rup' meaning 'Form' or 'Appearance'

in_telugu.name: Sorif
in_telugu.meaning: హిందూ పేరు అంటే Bringer of Happiness
in_telugu.long_meaning: Sorif ఒక హిందూ పేరు, ఇది భారతీయ సంస్కృతిలో లోతైన ఆధ్యాత్మిక ప్రాముఖ్యతను కలిగి ఉంది। One who brings joy and happiness to others, derived from the Sanskrit word 'Surya' meaning 'Sun' and 'Rup' meaning 'Form' or 'Appearance'

in_marathi.name: Sorif
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Bringer of Happiness
in_marathi.long_meaning: Sorif हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। One who brings joy and happiness to others, derived from the Sanskrit word 'Surya' meaning 'Sun' and 'Rup' meaning 'Form' or 'Appearance'

in_bengali.name: Sorif
in_bengali.meaning: হিন্দু নাম যার অর্থ Bringer of Happiness
in_bengali.long_meaning: Sorif একটি হিন্দু নাম যা ভারতীয় সংস্কৃতিতে গভীর আধ্যাত্মিক তাৎপর্য রাখে। One who brings joy and happiness to others, derived from the Sanskrit word 'Surya' meaning 'Sun' and 'Rup' meaning 'Form' or 'Appearance'
